description: Paired multi-turn conversations for comparing compact state, one bounded recent exchange, and full transcript history.
methodology: All strategies use the same model, schema, patient messages, deterministic engine, and expected final contract. The only changed input is how much prior dialogue is included in each extraction call.

scenarios.title: Required location is later removed
patient_turns: I want to book a dental cleaning.
I am a new patient.
I would prefer the Richmond location.
Actually, Richmond has to be the location.
Actually, any location is fine.
Please find the earliest available appointment.

scenarios.title: MRI facts, provider correction, and time correction
patient_turns: I need to book a knee MRI.
I am an existing patient.
My referral is on file.
I would prefer Dr. Hannah Nguyen.
Actually, any doctor is fine.
Friday mornings are best.
Actually, find the earliest available time instead.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous appointment is clarified, then provider is removed
patient_turns: I want to schedule a skin check.
I mean a skin cancer screening.
I am a new patient.
I would prefer Dr. Sarah Kim.
Actually, any provider is fine.
Please find the earliest available time.

scenarios.title: Short replies select and confirm a server-owned offer
patient_turns: I need a dental cleaning and I am a new patient.
The first one.
Yes.

scenarios.title: Information question does not erase an active booking request
patient_turns: I want to book a knee MRI.
I am an existing patient.
My referral is on file.
Where is Dr. Hannah Nguyen located?
Any doctor is fine.
Please find the earliest available appointment.
